title: Mandatory Food and Grocery Code of Conduct
summary: A mandatory Food and Grocery Code, with civil penalties, replaced the voluntary 2015 code from 1 April 2025 to address bargaining imbalances between large supermarkets/wholesalers and suppliers.

instruments.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Food and Grocery) Regulations 2024

commenced.what: Mandatory Food and Grocery Code commenced

direction_rationale: Constraining large retailers' conduct toward suppliers may protect smaller suppliers' viability (enhancing upstream), while compliance costs and reduced flexibility may raise costs for covered retailers.
comparison: none: national change (possible exposure-based designs across industries or firm sizes)

assessment.summary: A mandatory Food and Grocery Code with civil penalties governs how large supermarkets and wholesalers deal with suppliers. It counters the buying power of a concentrated retail sector, at a compliance cost.

marks.reason: Constrains the conduct of the stronger party in the supply chain, countering bargaining power.
Adds contracting, disclosure and dispute-resolution requirements.
